title: A coherent common generic lattice of two integral ideals
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $i:W\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $W$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Let $I,J$ be quasi-coherent ideals represented by $W.\mathrm{IdealSheafData}$ with $i_*I$ nonzero [def-pc-module-pullback] and $J\ne 0$. The pushforward $i_*I$ is coherent, and there exist a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $K$ [pqf-def-coherent] and monomorphisms $b:K\to i_*J$ and $d:K\to i_*I$ such that both maps on module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] at $i(\operatorname{genericPoint}(W))$ are isomorphisms. No assertion about cokernels is made.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_ideals_common_generic_lattice {X W : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (I J : W.IdealSheafData) (hI : ¬ IsZero ((pushforward i).obj I.toModules))
    (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ (K : X.Modules) (b : K ⟶ (pushforward i).obj J.toModules)
      (d : K ⟶ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace ((pushforward i).obj I.toModules) ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace K ∧ Mono b ∧ Mono d ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).map b) ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).map d)
